summary: The registrant filed an 8-K to report an amendment and restatement of its existing ABL term loan credit agreement. The amendment extends the maturity date by five years to June 18, 2031, and adjusts the applicable interest margin to either 4.00% or 7.00% depending on loan type, plus SOFR. The $45.0 million term loan remains secured by substantially all working capital assets, with the company as guarantor and subsidiaries as borrowers. This is a routine refinancing extension of a credit facility, not a special situation. What to watch: any future covenant changes or borrowing base adjustments that could signal financial stress.
